name: Funereal Hallucinations
body:
School illusion (phantasm)) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 6, cleric/oracle 7, mesmerist 6, psychic 7, shaman 7, sorcerer/wizard 7, witch 7

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target one living creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You complete the spell and fill the targets mind with the illusion that they have died and are on the path to their afterlife. If the target fail’s their save, they stand and march in place, taking no other action, including purely mental actions. The target is effectively helpless and takes no measures to defend itself. However, if the target takes any damage, is subject to a spell that imposes a detrimental condition or effect, or they reach the end of their turn, they get another saving throw to end the spell early.
